summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise filed an 8-K covering multiple routine items: a board size amendment to a cooperation agreement with Elliott, fiscal Q2 2026 earnings release, and appointment of board member Christopher P. Hsu. The cooperation agreement amendment capping board size post-2026 annual meeting is an administrative governance change, not a contested activist campaign. The earnings release and director appointment are standard disclosures. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is described. The items are normal corporate housekeeping and financial reporting.
